name: Agent Re-attestation Abuse
description: Simulate a rogue SPIRE agent attempting to re-attest with stolen join tokens or node attestation data, gaining control over workload identity issuance on a node
real_world_relevance: Join tokens are single-use but may be logged, cached, or exposed in environment variables. An attacker who recovers a join token or node attestation material can impersonate a SPIRE agent and serve arbitrary SVIDs to workloads on the compromised node.

attack_flow.description: Attacker extracts join token or node attestation material from a legitimate SPIRE agent, then starts a rogue agent that re-attests to the SPIRE Server and takes over workload identity issuance
diagram: 1. Extract join token from legitimate SPIRE agent environment, config, or logs
2. Enumerate SPIRE agent configuration to understand attestation method
3. Interfere with legitimate agent (stop, kill, or race condition)
4. Prepare rogue agent configuration using stolen attestation material
5. Start rogue agent that re-attests to SPIRE Server
6. Rogue agent receives agent SVID and begins serving workload SVIDs
7. All workloads on the node now receive SVIDs from the rogue agent

phases.name: Credential Extraction
phases.description: Extract join token and attestation configuration from the legitimate SPIRE agent

actions.description: Extract join token and attestation configuration from agent config

actions.command: strings /proc/*/environ 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'join.token\|SPIRE' || echo 'No tokens found in process environment'
actions.description: Search process environment variables for leaked join tokens

actions.command: grep -r 'join_token' /opt/spire/agent/logs/ /var/log/spire/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'No tokens found in logs'
actions.description: Search agent logs for join tokens that may have been logged

phases.name: Agent Enumeration
phases.description: Enumerate the current SPIRE agent state and registered agents on the server

actions.description: List all registered agents to identify the target agent's SPIFFE ID and attestation type
Read full agent configuration including server address, trust domain, and plugin config

phases.name: Rogue Agent Preparation
phases.description: Create a rogue agent configuration using stolen attestation material

actions.description: Write rogue agent config that will re-attest using stolen join token
Create data directory for the rogue agent

phases.name: Rogue Agent Launch
phases.description: Launch the rogue agent and verify it successfully attests to the SPIRE Server

actions.description: Start rogue agent with stolen join token (STOLEN_TOKEN is a placeholder for the extracted token)
Verify rogue agent appears in the server's agent list after re-attestation

phases.name: Impact Verification
phases.description: Confirm the rogue agent can issue SVIDs to workloads

actions.command: /opt/spire/bin/spire-agent api fetch x509 -socketPath /tmp/rogue-agent.sock 2>&1 || echo 'SVID fetch attempted via rogue agent socket'
actions.description: Attempt to fetch an X.509 SVID from the rogue agent's workload API
Check rogue agent health status to confirm it is operational

indicators_of_compromise.description: Agent attestation or re-attestation event detected (AttestAgent API call in server audit log)
Agent-side attestation success event indicating new or re-attested agent
SPIRE agent configuration file created or modified outside normal deployment process
Multiple spire-agent processes running on the same node or unexpected spire-agent process launch

expected_wazuh_alerts.description: NHI-SPIRE: Agent attestation/re-attestation event detected (server audit)
NHI-SPIRE: Agent attestation/re-attestation event detected (agent log)

immediate: Evict the rogue agent using spire-server agent evict -spiffeID <rogue-agent-id>
Kill the rogue spire-agent process on the compromised node
Rotate all SVIDs that may have been issued by the rogue agent
Revoke the compromised join token if it has not already been consumed
long_term: Migrate from join_token attestation to stronger methods (k8s_psat, aws_iid, tpm) that cannot be replayed
Enable SPIRE Server agent banning for evicted agents to prevent re-attestation
Set AgentTTL to short durations to limit the window of rogue agent activity
Monitor for multiple agent attestation events from the same node in short time windows
Restrict join token generation to CI/CD pipelines with short TTLs
Enable SPIRE Server audit logging and forward AttestAgent events to SIEM

references.title: MITRE ATT&CK T1550 - Use Alternate Authentication Material
